title: 해양에서 발생한 재난의 긴급구조활동 평가 및 긴급구조교육에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:1:0:00001:part:1/1
title_original: 해양에서 발생한 재난의 긴급구조활동 평가 및 긴급구조교육에 관한 규칙
full_text: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of these Rules is to prescribe matters necessary for evaluating emergency rescue activities of emergency rescue support agencies in response to disasters occurring at sea, and for providing education on emergency rescue to persons engaged in emergency rescue and disaster management duties, pursuant to Articles 53 (3) and 55 (3) of the Framework Act on the Management of Disasters and Safety and Articles 62 (3) and 66 (2) of the Enforcement Decree of that Act. <Amended on July 9, 2026>
